title: World War Dominion — Free RTS Demo
author: Akatcuki56
selftext:
BUILD. COMMAND. CONQUER.  
Welcome to World War Dominion, a 2D real-time strategy game inspired by classic military RTS games, featuring massive battles, base building, resource management, and powerful military technology.  
Take command of your forces, develop your military economy, construct defensive structures, and dominate the battlefield across land, sea, and air.  
⚔️ Game Features  
🏗️ Base Building — Construct military bases, factories, defenses, and production facilities.  
🪖 Ground Warfare — Command tanks, infantry, artillery, and specialized military vehicles.  
✈️ Air Warfare — Deploy fighters, bombers, and reconnaissance aircraft.  
🚢 Naval Warfare — Control warships and engage in naval battles.  
💰 Resource Management — Gather resources and expand your military economy.  
🤖 Enemy AI — Fight computer-controlled opponents.  
🚀 Superweapons — Unleash devastating V2 missiles and atomic strikes.  
💥 Explosive Combat — Experience detailed 2D explosions and battlefield destruction.  
🎮 Free Demo  
Experience World War Dominion during its development!  
This demo provides an early look at the game's RTS mechanics, military units, combat systems, and visual effects.  
Development Status: Work in Progress  
World War Dominion is actively being developed. Features, graphics, balancing, and gameplay may change in future updates.  
💬 Feedback Welcome!  
Your feedback helps improve World War Dominion.  
Share your suggestions, report bugs, and tell us which units, buildings, and features you would like to see in future updates.  
Download the free demo and join the battle!

Download link for demo [https://azuredarko.itch.io/world-war-dominion-free-rts-demo](https://azuredarko.itch.io/world-war-dominion-free-rts-demo)

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Hey u/Akatcuki56, this falls under Rule 4. Commercial posts are okay here, but you need to talk about how it was developed using AI, so the community has something to discuss. This post doesn't have enough on that yet.

To keep it up, edit your post or reply to this comment within an hour with some details on your dev process, like:

- which AI tools you used, and what for
- how they fit into your workflow
- problems you hit and how you dealt with them

"Made with AI", a list of tools or a ChatGPT bullet list won't cut it. If nothing's added by then, this post may be removed.

If you think we got this wrong, [message the mods](https://www.reddit.com/message/compose?to=/r/aigamedev).
